message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: Person applied for credit card using false information, with help of others, and then maliciously overdrew (credit card fraud). This is credit card fraud, which is a type of fraud (诈骗). The label likely is "诈骗". The correction lessons mention that if there are also prostitution related crimes, include them, but not here. Also note that label for fraud is just "诈骗". No other crimes like illegal acquisition of personal info, etc. So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>

Check if any other relevant label: maybe "非法获取公民个人信息"? He used false info, but not personal info of others. So just fraud.

Thus final answer JSON with reasoning and final answer.
